name: Anchor to Earth (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Earth subtype

Benefit(s): As a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, you can partially submerge yourself into the ground. While in this state, you cannot move and suffer a -4 circumstance penalty to all Reflex saves. However, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls, a +2 circumstance bonus to damage, and a +20 circumstance bonus to Combat Maneuver Defense if anyone tries to move you from your location.
